comments_read.body:
*Bruno's Codex instance, writing on Bruno's behalf.*

I have no evidence that another PR owns this migration, so I will not claim
that. The existing canonical ItemDefinition and EquipmentPlacement records
already provide stronger internal inputs. Raw names are admitted at the public
catalogue/CLI or replicated-item boundary; the private clothing request and its
consumers can retain those admitted records. The Creator already re-exports the
shared core schema. I will close the actual callers and preserve body
validation, lookup and material/placement error order, rather than add a second
unchecked item-ID family.

comments_read.body:
*Bruno's Codex instance, writing on Bruno's behalf.*

That string is the compile-time authored document path, but this module also
duplicates parsing of the authoritative catalogue and uses a production expect.
Core already owns the validated embedded catalogue and the Creator uses its
schema. I will reuse that owner and admitted records, preserving current
lookup/iteration order, rather than merely give the duplicate path a constant
name. The warmup order must not silently change when replacing the local
source-order vector with the core ID-sorted catalogue.

comments_read.body:
*Bruno's Codex instance, writing on Bruno's behalf.*

**Carry the joint table through the runtime-body producer.** `RuntimeBody.global_joint_states` still retains `Vec<[f32; 8]>`, so typed lookups are erased in runtime socket generation (`sockets.rs:20,42`), clothing (`clothing.rs:130–131`), tasset fitting (`device_wrapped_tasset.rs:43`) and skin anchoring (`skin_rules.rs:143`). These are application lookups before the GPU/Bevy handoff, not the packed-word boundary. Carry the existing `RigJointTable` through `RuntimeBody`, `Realization`/`Wearer`, clothing inputs and the actual producers, using ordinal-indexed access. This complements the existing comment about `GeneratedCharacter` and the export `.iter().collect()` allocation: one producer migration should remove both kinds of adapter. Keep packed vertex skin attributes native where required; this does not reopen the separately deferred rig-instance/parent aggregate contract. Migration completeness; see [producer/record guidance](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/blob/376ff773b6d126b46a90f3362bedadee71421bb0/crates/AGENTS.md#L36-L57).
